title: Day 2: Restore Admin Panel data loading (Suggestions + Question Gallery backend queries)

requirements.text: Implement backend query APIs required for Admin Panel data loading: (1) list questions filtered by subject for the Question Gallery, and (2) ensure suggestions listing continues to work with the existing listSuggestions() response shape used by the frontend.
acceptanceCriteria: Backend exposes a query method that returns all questions for a given subject (matching the subject values used by the frontend, e.g., "Physics", "Chemistry", "Mathematics").
The returned question records include the fields needed by the existing Question Gallery UI (id, subject, chapter, difficulty, questionText, options, image/preview if present).
The existing listSuggestions() method remains callable from the frontend and returns a response compatible with the generated TS types (suggestions array + count).

requirements.text: Wire the Question Management UI to real backend data by updating the React Query hook useGetQuestionsBySubject(subject) to call the new backend query API and return the fetched list instead of an empty array stub.
acceptanceCriteria: On Admin Panel > Question Gallery, changing the subject dropdown triggers a fetch and renders the returned questions instead of always showing an empty state.
If the backend call fails, the existing error UI in QuestionManagementPanel is shown ("Failed to load questions...").
The hook uses a stable React Query key that includes the subject (keeping the existing ['questionsBySubject', subject] pattern).

requirements.text: Ensure Suggestions Moderation loads and updates correctly end-to-end: the useGetAllSuggestions hook fetches from backend listSuggestions(), and after deleting a suggestion via useDeleteSuggestion(), the suggestions list refreshes (query invalidation) and the UI reflects the deletion.
acceptanceCriteria: Admin Panel > Suggestions & Feedback shows existing suggestions stored in the canister (not a placeholder).
Deleting a suggestion succeeds only for admins (backend-enforced), removes it from the backend, and the UI updates without a page refresh.
When there are no suggestions, the UI shows the existing empty state message "No suggestions submitted yet".

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo (no additional backend services).
Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui or any paths listed as immutable in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
Use English for any user-facing text.
nonGoals: Implementing full Question Gallery CRUD (upload/add question UI) beyond data loading (planned for a later day).
Implementing Create Test flows/APIs (planned for a later day).
Adding new authentication providers beyond Internet Identity.
